    Bar snacksWolfhouse giant pretzels with mustard butterGiant pretzels and mustard butter. Johann was no stable boyHow to make it1kg pizza dough90g bicarb soda1 eggrock salt, to taste125g butter2 tbsp wholegrain mustard1 tsp honey1 bunch radisheswhite vinegar, to taste3 L waterHeat the oven to 220°C.Divide the pizza dough into equal pieces and roll into 80cm ropes.Twist into pretzel shapes.Simmer the water with the bicarb soda and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds.Lay on lined trays, brush with egg, scatter with rock salt and bake 15 to 18 minutes until deep brown.Beat the soft butter with the wholegrain mustard and the honey.Serve with sliced radishes tossed in vinegar and salt.Landfill's beer garden ObatzdaCamembert and paprika on dark rye. Gil steps in for his brotherHow to make it250g camembert60g butter100g cream cheesesweet paprika, to tastecaraway seeds, to taste1 red onion1 can lager1 loaf dark rye bread1 bunch chivesMash the ripe camembert with a fork until mostly smooth.Beat in the soft butter, the cream cheese, the sweet paprika, a little caraway seeds, half a very finely diced red onion and the lager.Season with salt and pepper and chill 30 minutes.Spread on the slices of dark rye and top with thin red onion rings, chives and a dusting of paprika.PlatesSchnitzengiggle Tavern pork schnitzelCrumbed pork schnitzel with warm potato salad and cranberry jamHow to make it4 pork loin steaks1kg waxy potatoes100g diced baconwhite wine vinegar, to taste1 tbsp mustard100ml chicken stockvegetable oil, to taste1 bunch chivesplain flour, to taste2 eggs150g breadcrumbs50g butter1 lemon1 jar cranberry or lingonberry jamBoil the waxy potatoes 20 minutes and slice.Fry the diced bacon, add the white wine vinegar, the mustard, the stock and the oil and toss through the warm potatoes with chives.Pound the pork steaks to 5mm.Coat in flour, the beaten eggs and the breadcrumbs.Fry in the butter and the oil for 3 minutes a side, shaking the pan so the crumb puffs.Serve with lemon and cranberry jam.AftersApple strudelApples in puff pastry. Great Gam Gam knew about Beerfest all alongHow to make it4 green apples60g caster sugar1 tsp ground cinnamon60g sultanas2 sheets of puff pastry1 egg300ml thickened creamToss the sliced apples with the sugar, the cinnamon and the sultanas.Roll in the puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200°C for 30 minutes.Dust with icing sugar and serve with cream.Behind the barDas Boot lemon radlerLager and lemon soda. Das Boot! Das Boot!How to make it4 x 500ml cans of German lager100g sugar4 lemons600ml soda waterMake lemon syrup by simmering the sugar, the water and the zest of the lemons for 3 minutes, then add the juice of the lemons and chill.Mix the syrup with the cold soda water.Pour the cold German lager into each of the steins and top with the lemon soda.Add a lemon wheel.For non-drinkers, serve the lemon soda on its own over ice.Bavarian wheat beer by the steinChug like Landfill.
